description: The bar chart displays the F1 score (%) results for four different methods—MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding—evaluated across five datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 score in percentage, ranging from 80 to 100, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. For each dataset, three bars are shown, corresponding to the three methods: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). MADLLM achieves the highest F1 scores on all datasets, with the best performance observed on PSM, where it reaches approximately 98%. The MADLLM w/o feature embedding method generally performs worse than the full MADLLM model, with the largest drop in performance observed on SWaT, where its F1 score is around 86%. The MADLLM w/o skip embedding method consistently achieves F1 scores slightly lower than MADLLM but higher than MADLLM w/o feature embedding, indicating that both feature and skip embeddings contribute positively to the model's performance.
